g.text: Storefront and admin — logical state map
NOT a public lookup — refuses anything
the visitor neither owns nor just placed
is removed; staff sign in through the same
/login the storefront uses, then reach the
panel via "Admin panel" in the account menu,
which calls canAccessPanel() itself so the
link and the gate cannot disagree.
Guest and signed-in checkout converge here.
This is NOT the OrderStatus state machine —
that begins after this point and is driven by
of which visitor state placed the order.
